subject: integration
name: Ethereum standard (ETH_0_1)
summary: Defines Ethereum addresses and signatures of messages, typed data and transactions with the key of the address a site was given, plus a browser-only group that signs a series of transactions after one confirmation. It names a decoder compiled into the app that writes the confirmation text from the bytes to sign; the row holds no key and opens no connection. The definition refuses a typed-data domain for another chain, but whether a Crypto does is not checked here; that Crypto is judged on its own row. Level 4 with privacy: a definition plus a local decoder. Judged here by its publisher.
